bubbles.text_with_cues: [solemnly] There is NO GREATER LOSS than the... LOSS of FAITH.
[solemn] [thoughtful] Not in the belief of a power beyond your own perception...
[thoughtful] ...But in the ability to trust in one's self and in others.
[dramatic] To be besieged on all sides and feel like your entire world is about to...
[Solemnly] It can make any hardship feel like a RAGING STORM.
[dramatic] Seemingly unrelenting, exposing your weaknesses, and wrestling you into submission.
[solemn] But in your lowest moment... [long pause] always remember...
